quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil electronic copper foil capacity is 8 ten-thousand tons per year (as of the report date). 2025 output was 71,462 tons (up 32.31%, mainly higher capacity utilisation) and sales 72,070 tons (up 30.83%, on more high-end product sales); year-end inventory 2,781 tons. The report says supply of the HVLP copper foil used in high-end PCBs was tight, with demand exceeding supply, and copper foil for high-frequency / high-speed substrates was in short supply; high-end HVLP copper foil output rose 232% year on year and output of 5 micron and thinner lithium-battery foil grew steadily. It adds that because industry capacity is huge, the market as a whole was still oversupplied and fiercely competitive, with only some high-end products carrying high added value.
quarterly_data.figure: capacity 8 ten-thousand tons per year; 2025 output 71,462 tons (+32.31%); HVLP output +232%

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil high-frequency / high-speed foil status (2025 annual report): HVLP1-4 generation copper foil was supplied in volume to customers during 2025, and its self-developed high-end HVLP foil achieved scaled exports; the company says its RTF foil production and sales capability ranks first among domestic-funded makers and that its self-developed high-end products have passed certification at leading international companies and begun volume supply. Its R&D table lists IC-package carrier copper foil (thin-foil thickness 1.5-5 micron) as technology development basically complete with process optimisation under way, aimed at package-substrate copper foil; HVLP4 and RTF4 copper foil at the key-technology stage, with the target of specifications matching the imported products of Japan's Mitsui; HTE foil for high-frequency substrates and foil for high-frequency microwave composite dielectric boards completed.
quarterly_data.figure: HVLP1-4 in volume supply; carrier copper foil (1.5-5 micron) development basically complete; HVLP4 / RTF4 at key-technology stage

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil construction in progress was RMB 4,874,712.38 at end-2025. Its HVLP high-precision electronic copper foil surface-treatment upgrade project (97.62% of budget invested) and the Tongling RTF surface-treatment upgrade project (87.16% of budget invested) were both 99% complete, with RMB 51,851,139.36 of the RTF project transferred to fixed assets in 2025; cash paid for fixed and other long-term assets was RMB 312,859,728.28. The IPO-funded capacity projects did not reach their expected returns: the 2 ten-thousand-ton phase-II ultra-thin foil project (usable from September 2023) because HTE foil competition kept processing fees below expectations and its share of high-end PCB foil output is low; the 1 ten-thousand-ton Tongling and 1.5 ten-thousand-ton electronic copper foil projects (usable from June 2024) because lithium-battery foil competition was fierce and unit processing fees low.
quarterly_data.figure: CIP RMB 4,874,712.38; HVLP and RTF surface-treatment upgrades 99% complete; capex cash RMB 312,859,728.28

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil 2026 business plan (2025 annual report, company outlook): expand the high-end copper foil market by raising yields of high-end products such as RTF and HVLP, build strategic cooperation with power-battery and high-end PCB companies, expand in Southeast Asia and prepare to enter the North American and European markets; push automation (surface-treatment inspection, dosing systems, MES), cost reduction and production-line upgrades; step up R&D and industrialisation of new products. The company says it will actively expand release of high-end product capacity, and flags the risk that its HVLP market share could fall as more companies develop and produce HVLP foil, although production is difficult and certification cycles are long.
